952. Knapsack Problem-2

70

Hard

Problem Statement:
Given two numbers N, W, and two arrays each containing N integers(1 Weight array,1 Value array), print the maximum value that can be obtained by picking a list of elements with total weight <=W.
input_spec:
The first line consists of N and W space-separated values denoting the size of the array and weight.
The following line consists of two space-separated arrays of size N.
